dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: O—Oh, it's nothing really, I just... dropped a few things... that broke.

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: But it's not all my fault. If she'd listened to me and replaced everything with wood or iron, then none of this would've happened!

dialogues.speaker: Mikko
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't know what I'm going to do if she's still angry...
